name: High refresh rate gaming monitor
summary: A display with a high refresh rate and fast pixel response makes motion clearer and feels more responsive, provided your PC or console can actually produce frames to match.
lookFor: Refresh rate of 144 Hz or higher for fast shooters, and a graphics card that can drive it
Variable refresh rate support (G-Sync Compatible or FreeSync) that works over your connection
Panel type and response time: look for independent measurements rather than a single manufacturer number
Resolution matched to your GPU: 1080p and 1440p are common choices for high frame rates
A stand that adjusts for height, or a VESA mount
suitableFor: Players of fast competitive games whose hardware already reaches high frame rates in the games they play.
pros: Lower display latency than a 60 Hz screen at matching frame rates
Supports adaptive sync for tear-free play
cons: No benefit if your game runs at 60 FPS
Higher resolutions demand much more GPU power
Panel quality varies widely at similar prices
